meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Unrestrained
meta.description: The thoughts embedded in the code transcend 0s and 1s.

units.rawText: ...No, I will find my way out of this destiny.
units.displayText: ...No, I will find my way out of this destiny.

spans.text: ...No, I will find my way out of this destiny.

units.rawText: I will stop the war in Cyclopes, and prevent more senseless killing.
units.displayText: I will stop the war in Cyclopes, and prevent more senseless killing.

spans.text: I will stop the war in Cyclopes, and prevent more senseless killing.

units.rawText: Death is merely escapism. I've already resolved to carry my burden, and continue on my path with the Professor.
units.displayText: Death is merely escapism. I've already resolved to carry my burden, and continue on my path with the Professor.

spans.text: Death is merely escapism. I've already resolved to carry my burden, and continue on my path with the Professor.

units.rawText: Even if my memories are lost to a reset, I will not hesitate to recollect my past.
units.displayText: Even if my memories are lost to a reset, I will not hesitate to recollect my past.

spans.text: Even if my memories are lost to a reset, I will not hesitate to recollect my past.

units.rawText: Perhaps I have stood here many times already, but this time the outcome will be different.
units.displayText: Perhaps I have stood here many times already, but this time the outcome will be different.

spans.text: Perhaps I have stood here many times already, but this time the outcome will be different.

units.rawText: This time, I know for what I wield my weapon.
units.displayText: This time, I know for what I wield my weapon.

spans.text: This time, I know for what I wield my weapon.

units.rawText: I know who I wish to protect.
units.displayText: I know who I wish to protect.

spans.text: I know who I wish to protect.

units.rawText: For them, I will pay any price, even if that is for which I lay down my life.
units.displayText: For them, I will pay any price, even if that is for which I lay down my life.

spans.text: For them, I will pay any price, even if that is for which I lay down my life.
